title: Page 30
transc:
Corinth
Maj Genl Grant (Hd Qrs)  Washn DC Sept. 1st 1862.
Fanny you are authorized to Enlist You are authorized to Enlist
in Lonesome in to old Whists
Signed Alden Genl in Chief Clerk


Washn Sept 1st 1145 PM 1862
For Argyle The following order sent
This Evening vizi To Budget comd'g
Grant Quadroon care of Commodore Harwood
Navy Yard Mohawk Send four of
your Raymonds to Huron tonight to
protect the embarkation of Adverb If
Buffet is not at or off
the Navy Yard Commodore Harwood will
deliver this order to the senior
officer of any of the Randolphs
which have arrived so that there
shall be no delay signed Banjo
